description: This file contains extension methods for configuring and adding default services such as health checks, OpenTelemetry, and service discovery to a .NET host application. It also includes methods for setting up health check endpoints in a web application.

classes.name: Extensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring services, health checks, OpenTelemetry, and endpoints in a .NET application.

methods.name: AddServiceDefaults
methods.description: Configures default services including OpenTelemetry, health checks, and service discovery for the host application.

methods.name: ConfigureOpenTelemetry
methods.description: Sets up OpenTelemetry logging and metrics instrumentation, and adds exporters based on configuration.

methods.name: AddOpenTelemetryExporters
methods.description: Adds OpenTelemetry exporters such as OTLP and Azure Monitor based on configuration settings.

methods.name: AddDefaultHealthChecks
methods.description: Adds default health checks, including a liveness check.

methods.name: MapDefaultEndpoints
methods.description: Maps health check endpoints for development environment, with considerations for security.
